title: Inside the Cell
style: flat pastel illustration, clean ink outlines, playful storybook style, single subject, plain off-white background, minimal

concepts.title: Nucleus
concepts.explanation: Control center that stores DNA and directs the cell.
concepts.prompt: a giant golden vault shaped like a brain, guarded by a tiny general holding a DNA scroll

concepts.title: Mitochondria
concepts.explanation: Powerhouse that turns glucose into ATP energy.
concepts.prompt: a muscular bean wearing boxing gloves punching sugar cubes into glowing lightning bolts

concepts.title: Ribosome
concepts.explanation: Tiny factory that builds proteins from RNA instructions.
concepts.prompt: a small chef made of two dumplings knitting a long chain of colorful beads from a recipe ribbon

concepts.title: Endoplasmic Reticulum
concepts.explanation: Folded highway network that makes and moves proteins and lipids.
concepts.prompt: a twisting rollercoaster of pink ribbon with tiny packages riding the carts

concepts.title: Golgi Apparatus
concepts.explanation: Post office that packages and ships proteins.
concepts.prompt: a stack of pancakes running a post office, wrapping gifts with bows and stamping them

concepts.title: Lysosome
concepts.explanation: Recycling crew that digests waste with enzymes.
concepts.prompt: a hungry purple bubble with a huge mouth eating old shoes and broken bicycles

concepts.title: Cell Membrane
concepts.explanation: Selective barrier that controls what enters and leaves.
concepts.prompt: a bouncer made of soap bubbles at a velvet rope, letting only some marbles pass

concepts.title: Chloroplast
concepts.explanation: Solar panel of plant cells that makes sugar from light.
concepts.prompt: a green frog in sunglasses sunbathing on a stack of solar panels, sweating sugar cubes
